title: Google Maps Business Lead Scraper Input

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: List of keywords and locations to search for.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

includeFields.title: Include Fields
includeFields.description: Optional list of fields to include in the output. If empty, all available fields are returned.

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Only return businesses with at least this rating (0-5).

requireWebsite.title: Require Website
requireWebsite.description: Only return businesses that have a website.

requirePhone.title: Require Phone
requirePhone.description: Only return businesses that have a phone number.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate Results
deduplicate.description: Remove duplicate businesses from the final results.
